## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--minnie-may.md)

[Anne](../character/anne.md) saved [Minnie](../character/minnie.md) May's life when the young child fell dangerously ill with croup while her parents were away. Drawing on her past experience caring for children, [Anne](../character/anne.md) rushed to the [Barry](../character/barry.md) home and successfully treated her. This act of rescue resolved the rift between their families, prompting [Minnie](../character/minnie.md) May's mother to forgive [Anne](../character/anne.md) and allow her to resume her friendship with [Diana](../character/diana.md).
